title: Analyzer manifest
description: Output of `<analyzer> manifest`. Contract version 1.2.0. Changing this file requires a schemaVersion bump and a record in docs/DECISIONS.md.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the contracts this analyzer speaks. Must equal x-contractVersion of the schemas it was built for.

paradigms.description: Paradigms the language supports. Whether a module actually shows one is reported per module in facts.

files.description: Globs, relative to the analysis root with / separators, of the files this analyzer reads ("**/*.ext"). A host without a workspace file starts the analyzer only when at least one file matches. Which of the matching files are analyzed (generated code, vendored code) stays the analyzer's decision. Added in 1.2.0.

semantic.description: True when the analyzer resolves symbols with the language's own semantic model. False means names only.

supportedRules.description: Rule IDs this analyzer implements detectors for. Must equal the set of ids in `rules`.

partialAnalysis.description: True when `analyze --files` produces correct facts for the listed files without the rest of the project.

paradigms.description: Paradigms the rule applies to. Empty means any module.

rules.description: Descriptors of the implemented rules. The authoritative definition of each shared rule lives in spec/rules/*.yaml; this list only states what this build implements.

paradigmId.description: Known values are listed in spec/paradigms.md; the set is open.

ruleId.description: Shared rules have no prefix (CC001); language-specific rules carry a language code prefix (CS.NAM001).
